**Job Description**
===================


**Roles and Responsibilities**

  

  

* Managing assigned customer service requests end\-to\-end — from initial inquiry and quotation through order fulfillment, delivery, and issue closure.
* Preparing and issuing accurate, timely quotations in response to assigned service requests, ensuring alignment with technical and commercial requirements.
* Managing the Inquiry to Order (ITO) process for assigned requests, including coordinating commercial and contractual details with internal stakeholders (engineering, operations, logistics, finance).
* Tracking assigned service requests and orders to ensure timely delivery, proactively communicating status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinating with internal teams (engineering, field service, supply chain) to resolve assigned customer issues, escalations, and technical queries efficiently.
* Ensuring service excellence by monitoring resolution times, quality, and customer satisfaction for assigned requests.
* Communicating clearly with customers throughout the lifecycle of assigned requests, setting expectations and managing follow\-ups.
* Identifying recurring issues or service gaps within assigned accounts and escalating/collaborating with relevant teams (Marketing, Product Line, Engineering) to drive improvement.
* Applying Six Sigma analytical tools, including Root Cause Analysis (RCA), to support resolution of reliability issues and drive continuous improvement in service delivery.
* Maintaining accurate records of service requests, interactions, and resolutions within CRM/ERP systems.
* Supporting strong working relationships with customers on assigned requests to promote satisfaction and repeat engagement.
* Regularly reporting to the APAC Services Operations Manager on assigned request status, open issues, and service delivery performance.
* Staying informed on customer needs, product/service requirements, and regional market conditions relevant to assigned accounts.
* Collaborating with the Services Product Line team to relay customer feedback and support development of new/improved service offerings.
* If you are a detail\-oriented, technically proficient professional passionate about delivering exceptional customer service in the Power Conversion sector across India/APAC, we encourage you to apply for this opportunity with GE Power Conversion.

* Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college/university in Electrical Engineering or allied Engineering discipline. (Master's degree a plus.)
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in customer service, account management, technical support, or service operations.
* Offshore industry experience and process knowledge in one or more of: Metal, Marine, Oil \& Gas, Test Bench, Material Handling, or Power Plant sectors.
* Knowledge of Power Electronics, High Voltage Equipment, and PLC systems.
* Experience with quotation preparation and ITO (Inquiry to Order) processes.
* Willingness to travel across India/APAC region as required.
  

  

**Desired Characteristics**

  

  

* Prior experience with MV/LV drives, industrial automation systems, and large motors and generators.
* Proficient in both oral and written communication in English (additional regional languages a plus).
* Strong organizational and follow\-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent service requests.
* Customer\-centric mindset with a focus on responsiveness and issue resolution.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with engineering, field service, and supply chain teams.

* Experience with CRM/ERP systems for tracking service requests and orders.
* Demonstrated technical proficiency coupled with strong customer service orientation

title: Director, Demand Generation
description:
**About Rocketlane**
--------------------


Rocketlane is redefining how professional services teams operate. With the launch of **Nitro**, our AI platform for Professional Services and Delivery teams, we've introduced agents (like the Migration Agent, Documentation Agent, Workforce Agent, and Signals) that fundamentally change what PS teams can accomplish. Nitro doesn't just automate work; it shows what's possible when AI is built into the fabric of how services are delivered.


We're not chasing the crowded install base. We're creating a new category, and we need someone who knows how to make a market believe in something before it's obvious.


**The Role**
------------


This is not a playbook\-execution job.


The traditional demand gen toolkit (Google Ads, webinars, event sponsorships) won't build the market we need. Our buyers (VPs of Professional Services) don't convert from a gated white paper. They convert when they *see* something that makes them think: "I had no idea that was possible."


Your job is to make them see it.


You'll own the full demand strategy for Nitro: discovering new channels before they're saturated, producing content that earns attention in an age where attention is the scarcest resource, and building a repeatable engine for channel exploration, not channel management.


You run experiments, not campaigns. You find channels, you don't inherit them.


**What You'll Own**
-------------------


**Market Education \& Category Creation**


* Build the narrative around what AI\-native professional services *looks like*, using Nitro's Migration Agent and other agents as proof points
* Create content (especially visual/video) that shows possibilities, not just features
* Make VP PS the audience that forwards your stuff to their peers

**Channel Experimentation**


* Design a structured test\-and\-learn system to identify emerging, non\-obvious demand channels: dark social, niche communities, LinkedIn creator plays, short\-form video, practitioner\-led content
* Kill failing experiments fast; scale winners before they become crowded
* Maintain an active "channel hypothesis backlog" and always be running the next test

**Pipeline Creation**


* Drive qualified pipeline into sales through a mix of inbound pull and targeted ABX for high\-value PS leader accounts
* Partner closely with Sales to calibrate ICP, signal quality, and follow\-up sequencing
* Own the funnel metrics that matter: awareness velocity, ICP engagement, pipeline influenced, sales cycle acceleration

**Brand in Market**


* Position Rocketlane as the definitive voice in AI\-for\-PS, not just a tool vendor
* Build an external presence for Rocketlane's founders and subject\-matter experts as trusted voices in the PS community

**The Profile We're Looking For**
---------------------------------


### **The 2026 Demand Leader Is Different**


The old model (hire someone who managed $5M in Google Ads and ran quarterly webinars) is broken. The attention economy has made buyers immune to that playbook. We're looking for someone who has shown a consistent pattern of finding channels *before* they peak, extracting outsized value, and moving on before they become noise.


**You've got at least 2 big wins under your belt.** Not "contributed to growth." You *drove* something: a new channel that wasn't in the plan, a campaign that became the company's signature move, a GTM motion that others later tried to copy. You can tell the story in 60 seconds and back it up with numbers.


**You have a framework for finding and killing ideas fast.** A hypothesis backlog, a bias for cheap tests, and a ruthless ability to read signal from noise early. You've killed your own ideas before leadership told you to.


**You live in the attention economy.** You understand why a 90\-second LinkedIn video from a practitioner can outperform $50k in paid ads. You've used dark social, community seeding, and creator distribution, not because you read about them, but because you've run them.


**You've marketed something people didn't know they needed.** Category creation, new product category, or a feature set that required explaining the problem before selling the solution. You know what it feels like to market upstream of demand.


**You're a builder, not just a manager.** At our stage, the Head of Demand Gen writes copy, tests ads themselves, gets on calls with practitioners to understand the persona, and ships things without a full team behind them.
  

  

**You execute with a high quality bar.** You have taste and judgment for what great looks like. When you back an idea or hypothesis, you do it justice ensuring there's real confidence that it's been explored to its fullest potential, not just checked off the list.


**Must\-Have Experience**
-------------------------


* 7\-12 years in demand generation (B2B SaaS preferred, but strong B2C candidates with a track record of channel experimentation and audience building are equally welcome), with at least 2 stints where you were a key driver of measurable growth inflection
* Demonstrated ability to discover and exploit new/underused channels, with specific examples from at least 2 different companies (the same channel trick twice doesn't count)
* Experience marketing to senior buyers (VP / C\-suite) in enterprise or mid\-market B2B
* Proven track record with content\-led or video\-led demand motions, not just paid search
* Hands\-on experience with modern GTM tooling: Clay, HubSpot or equivalent, LinkedIn paid, intent data, influencer marketing, attribution approaches for dark social
* Strong creative judgment: you can brief a video, write a hook, and know when something will land

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Marketed an AI product, especially one that required educating the market on new possibilities rather than competing on features
* Experience at a company that grew through a "show don't tell" motion (demo\-led, video\-first, or practitioner\-community\-led)
* Background in or exposure to the PS / consulting / implementation world
* Built UGC or customer\-voice content programs
* Managed a small team or agency pod while also being personally hands\-on

### **What We Won't Hire**


* Someone who optimizes existing channels exceptionally well but hasn't *created* demand from new ones
* A "demand gen operator" whose primary skill is campaign setup and reporting
* Anyone whose answer to "how do you find new channels" is "I read industry reports and benchmark against competitors"
* Someone who needs 6 months to develop a strategy before testing anything

### **What Success Looks Like**


**90 days:** You've run 3\-5 channel experiments, identified 1\-2 high\-signal channels to double down on, and have a clear point of view on how Rocketlane Nitro should show up in market.


**6 months:** A repeatable demand motion is live. VP PS leaders in ICP accounts know Rocketlane and associate us with what AI\-native PS looks like. Pipeline from non\-traditional channels is measurable and growing.


**12 months:** Rocketlane is the brand that VP PS professionals cite when talking about AI transforming their function. You've built a channel playbook others would try to replicate.


### **Why This Role Is Special**


* You'll be working directly with the founders, with no 3\-layer approval chains
* You have a real product story to tell. Nitro's Migration Agent is genuinely new. The possibilities aren't marketing spin; they're real
* You'll have budget and latitude to experiment, not just optimize
* This is a category\-creation moment. The person who builds this playbook writes the case study that others reference for years

  

**Why join us?**


At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:


* Impact and ownership: You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* Work with the best: We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* Celebrate wins: Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* Learn and grow: We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* Flexibility and balance: While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).
  

  

*Rocketlane is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to building a team where everyone can do their best work.*

description:
**About Rocketlane**


Rocketlane is a fast\-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in customer onboarding and professional services automation.

We’re a close\-knit team of over 100 passionate professionals, all focused on building a product that teams love to use. Our journey has been fueled by $45M in funding from top investors, including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners.


#### **Role summary**


At Rocketlane, content has never been an afterthought. It’s been the engine that helps us build trust with the people we serve. Our customers, professional services leaders, delivery teams, and operations experts, come to Rocketlane not just for software, but for insight. They look to us to understand how the industry is evolving, how high\-performing teams operate, and how they can deliver better outcomes for their customers.That’s why content plays a central role in how we build our brand.


Rocketlane is defining the modern way services teams deliver work. So we’re not just explaining a product, we’re shaping how the market thinks about service delivery, project success, and the future of delivery in an agentic world.


So this isn’t a traditional content writer role. We’re looking for someone who thinks like a Product Marketer, researches like an analyst, and writes like a storyteller. Someone who can turn product ideas, customer problems, and industry shifts into narratives that matter.


You’ll help shape how Rocketlane communicates ideas about service delivery, customer onboarding, and the future of project execution. You’ll work closely with founders and product teams, and you’ll have the autonomy to explore ideas that move the conversation forward. And you’ll have a lot of fun along the way :)


If you see writing as a tool for thinking, teaching, and shaping perspective, you’ll fit right in.


#### **What you’ll do**


* **Own high\-impact content across formats** Develop both long\-form and short\-form content: blogs, landing pages, playbooks, customer stories, sales enablement assets, email copy, video scripts, and more.
* **Develop deep understanding of our customers** Understand their personas, workflows, and challenges to craft stories grounded in real problems and outcomes.
* **Work closely with people who care deeply about the product** Work closely with Product Marketing, Product, Sales, Customer Success, Demand Gen, and Design to bring ideas to life.
* **Think distribution, not just creation** Ensure content travels effectively across channels like blog, LinkedIn, email, video, community, and events.
* **Find the ideas worth talking about** Explore the problems our audience cares about and develop narratives that help them think differently about how they operate.

#### **The kind of person who thrives in this role**


* **Product curiosity** You’re curious about how products and businesses work. You enjoy digging into features, workflows, and customer problems until you can explain them simply.
* **Tech\-to\-human translation** You can turn complex product ideas, technical concepts, or operational workflows into clear, engaging narratives.
* **Customer instincts** You don’t write in abstraction. You want to understand who the customer is, what pressures they face, and what success looks like for them.
* **Perspective, not just words** You don’t just summarize information, you develop viewpoints grounded in research and thinking.
* **Impact mindset** You care about what happens after something is published. Did people read it? Share it? Act on it? Did it help them understand the product better?
* **Collaborative by default** You’re comfortable working with Product, PMMs, Sales, Customer teams, and founders to shape content together.
* **Distribution awareness** An understanding that great content needs to travel and that ideas adapt across channels like LinkedIn, YouTube, email, and community.
* **Obsession for the Craft** You don’t settle for “good enough.” You refine ideas, sharpen arguments, and make every piece better with each pass. You bring a healthy creator’s pride to your work.
* **Experience** Ideally 3–5 years in B2B SaaS content marketing, editorial, or product storytelling roles. If you have slightly less or more experience but believe this role fits your trajectory, we’d still love to hear from you.
**Bonus points**


While not required, a few things that would make someone especially strong in this role:


**Multi\-Format Storytelling:** You’re comfortable thinking beyond text: video scripts, short\-form content, social narratives, or visual storytelling.


**SEO Fundamentals** You understand the basics of search intent, structure, and discoverability, even if it’s not your primary focus.


**Industry Curiosity** You enjoy understanding industries and operational workflows, especially how services teams deliver projects and outcomes for customers.


**How We Work**


#### **We operate in a high\-agency environment.**


People here take ownership of problems, not just tasks. If you see an opportunity to explain something better, frame an idea differently, or explore a new narrative, you run with it.


At the same time, we care deeply about thoughtfulness and craft.


We believe the best content comes from people who take the time to understand a problem deeply, develop a perspective, and communicate it clearly.


**What Great Content Looks Like at Rocketlane**


Great content at Rocketlane doesn’t just inform, it helps our audience think differently and operate better. When we evaluate content, we look for a few things:


**Clarity over complexity** The best content explains sophisticated ideas in simple, structured ways. If a concept is complex, the writing makes it clearer — not harder to understand.


**Customer truth** Great content is grounded in how customers actually work — their workflows, pressures, and goals — not just product features.


**Perspective** We value writing that brings a point of view. The best pieces don’t just summarize trends; they interpret them and explain why they matter.


**Product credibility** Our content reflects a deep understanding of the product. It connects ideas and insights back to how Rocketlane helps solve real problems.


**Teach something meaningful** A reader should walk away with something useful, a new way of thinking, a practical idea, or a clearer understanding of a problem they care about.


**Craft and structure** Strong writing has flow, structure, and intentionality. Every paragraph moves the idea forward.


**If this Sounds Like You…**


We care deeply about how ideas are expressed. The quality of thinking behind the writing matters as much as the writing itself.


Instead of just sending a resume, share:


* A few pieces of work you’re proud of
* Something you’ve written that changed how people thought about a topic
* Or even a rewrite of a section of the Rocketlane website that you think could be better

**Why join us?**


At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:


* **Impact and ownership**: You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best**: We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins**: Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow**: We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* **Flexibility and balance**: While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).

Beetloop is building a B2B technology and marketplace ecosystem for regulated product industries, connecting businesses across Food, Nutraceuticals, Cosmetics, Ingredients, Manufacturing, Testing, Packaging, Logistics, and related services.

As Beetloop expands into international markets, we are looking for an **MBA Intern – International Marketing \& Strategic Partnerships** to support global market development, business partnerships, B2B marketing, and international business communication.

Job Summary

The intern will work closely with Beetloop’s leadership and business development team to support the company’s international expansion initiatives.

The role involves **global market research, partner identification, B2B marketing, business communication, outreach, competitor intelligence, and partnership development**.

The ideal candidate should be interested in **International Business, International Marketing, Strategic Partnerships, B2B Marketing, and Business Development**, with strong research, communication, analytical, and relationship\-building skills.

This is a **business\-focused role and not purely a content\-writing position**. The intern will be expected to contribute to the complete process of identifying and developing international opportunities.

Key Responsibilities1\. International Market Research \& Expansion

* Research potential international markets and identify business opportunities for Beetloop.
* Study country\-specific industry landscapes, customer segments, competitors, regulations, associations, and business ecosystems.
* Identify relevant opportunities across **North America, Europe, Middle East, Asia\-Pacific, Central Asia, and emerging markets**.
* Monitor developments in FoodTech, Nutraceuticals, Cosmetics, Manufacturing, AI, SaaS, B2B marketplaces, and other regulated\-product industries.
* Prepare concise **market research reports, country briefs, and opportunity assessments** for management review.
* Identify potential market\-entry opportunities based on industry trends and business requirements.

2\. Strategic Partnerships \& Business Development

* Identify and research potential international partners across relevant industries and ecosystems.
* Build prospect lists covering:
* Industry associations and trade organizations
* Chambers of commerce and business networks
* Universities and research institutions
* Accelerators and incubators
* Manufacturers and contract manufacturers
* Ingredient and raw\-material companies
* Testing and certification laboratories
* Technology and SaaS companies
* Consulting and regulatory organizations
* Logistics and supply\-chain providers
* Trade shows, conferences, and event organizers
* Identify relevant founders, executives, business heads, partnership managers, and other decision\-makers.
* Research organizations to understand their business, requirements, and potential areas of collaboration.
* Develop customized partnership propositions and collaboration opportunities.
* Support the leadership team in initiating discussions and developing strategic relationships.
* Coordinate meetings, follow\-ups, and communication with prospective partners.
* Maintain an updated partnership pipeline covering **prospects, contacts, communication, status, next actions, and outcomes**.

3\. International B2B Marketing

* Support Beetloop’s international positioning and market\-development strategy.
* Research target customer and partner segments across different countries and industries.
* Develop relevant messaging for international B2B audiences.
* Support campaigns, industry outreach, partner marketing, webinars, events, and ecosystem initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for:
* Co\-marketing
* Knowledge partnerships
* Industry collaborations
* Webinars and events
* Joint initiatives
* Ecosystem partnerships
* Assist in strengthening Beetloop’s visibility among relevant international business communities.

4\. Business Communication \& Marketing Content

* Prepare professional business materials for international audiences, including:
* Partnership proposals
* Collaboration pitches
* Business introduction emails
* LinkedIn outreach messages
* Corporate presentations
* Partnership decks
* Market briefs
* Brochures
* Case studies
* Website and business\-development content
* Convert technical, regulatory, and business information into clear and professional B2B communication.
* Customize communication based on **country, industry, organization type, and target audience**.
* Ensure consistency in Beetloop’s brand messaging and professional communication standards.

5\. Competitor \& Industry Intelligence

* Research international B2B platforms, marketplaces, technology companies, and industry ecosystems.
* Track competitor offerings, business models, market positioning, and partnership approaches.
* Monitor relevant industry developments, emerging trends, and new business opportunities.
* Identify market gaps and potential areas for Beetloop’s expansion.
* Prepare competitor intelligence and industry reports to support strategic discussions.

6\. Outreach \& Relationship Management

* Support international outreach through:
* Email
* LinkedIn
* Business networks
* Industry associations
* Conferences and trade events
* Online meetings
* Maintain professional communication with prospective organizations and decision\-makers.
* Follow up systematically on active opportunities.
* Coordinate internally with leadership and business development teams to move qualified opportunities forward.
* Track each opportunity from **research and qualification through outreach, meeting, follow\-up, and partnership discussion**.

* Currently pursuing or recently completed an **MBA / PGDM**.

* International Business
* International Marketing
* Marketing
* Strategy
* Business Development

Essential Skills

* Strong professional and business communication skills.

* Ability to research companies, industries, markets, and decision\-makers.

About the Company

We are a leading hygiene products manufacturer in India, offering **plant\-based, eco\-conscious solutions across personal care categories**. Our products are developed in certified facilities and recognized through multiple national and state awards.

With a growing team of **55\+ employees**, we foster a supportive, ethical, and performance\-driven work culture. We value innovation, quality, and collaboration, providing a positive work environment where individuals can learn, contribute, and grow with a purpose\-led brand.

* Support regular posting of content across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant channels.

* Schedule posts according to the approved content plan.
* Ensure posts are published on time and follow brand guidelines.
* Monitor basic engagement and audience responses.

* Identify high\-performing and low\-performing content.
* Support the team in identifying areas for content improvement.

* Track content status from idea to approval, design, publishing, and reporting.
* Maintain records of published posts, captions, creatives, videos, and campaign materials.

* Ensure product information and communication are accurate before publishing.
* Support the team during product launches and marketing activities.

* Strong interest in social media and digital marketing.
* Good understanding of major social media platforms.
* Good communication and writing skills.
* Basic understanding of social media trends and content formats.
* Creative thinking and willingness to experiment with new content ideas.

* Social media management
* Content creation
* Instagram and Facebook management
* LinkedIn content
* Reels and short\-form video content
* Caption writing
* Hashtag research
* Competitor research
* Trend analysis
* Community management
* Influencer coordination
* Basic digital marketing knowledge
* Content calendar management

* Adobe Photoshop – added advantage

* Good communication skills
* Good writing ability

title: Creative Head
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Creative Manager to join our team and work closely with the evolving Maarrs product

portfolio.

This is not a conventional Creative Manager role.

The role combines hands\-on creative production, design execution, video creation, team formation and

leadership, and UI/UX quality oversight, and will require the individual to work across different creative

aspects of the product and business.

As an early\-stage startup, we believe that roles cannot always be restricted to a fixed job description.

Everyone is expected to contribute wherever required, take ownership and help build the organisation and

product.

Most importantly, we are not looking for someone who already knows everything.

Creative tools, production techniques, product knowledge and new AI\-enabled creative capabilities can all be

learned and developed over time. What is much harder to teach is attitude, ownership, work ethic, curiosity,

adaptability and willingness to learn and contribute.

That is what we value most.

**What We Are Looking For**

**We are looking for someone who:**

 Has a strong work ethic and takes ownership of commitments.

 Has a genuine willingness to work and contribute, rather than waiting to be told what to do.

 Is curious and has a willingness to explore, question and understand.

 Is willing to learn new creative skills, tools and ways of working.

 Can operate comfortably in an environment where things are still being built and refined.

 Is flexible and adaptable when priorities or responsibilities change.

 Can work across creative functions rather than being restricted by a narrow job description.

 Is comfortable taking responsibility for something and following it through to completion.

 Can think beyond the immediate creative task and understand where the product and brand are heading in the

future.

 Wants to build their own capabilities and career alongside the growth of the product and organisation.

 Has good professional ethics, reliability and discipline.

 Can work independently while also collaborating effectively with others.

 Brings structure and clarity even when the situation itself is not completely structured.

The role will broadly operate across creative production, design, video and creative team management:

 Work closely with the CEO on creative execution and production priorities.

 Build, develop and lead the creative team across design and video functions, with hands\-on creative

production remaining a core responsibility.

 Oversee the UI/UX and front\-end design department — reviewing and ensuring quality of output, not hands\-on

execution.

 Drive creative marketing ideas and campaign concepts.

 Create and execute end\-to\-end video production, including 2D animation, 3D animation, motion graphics,

AI\-generated video and video editing, while also overseeing the quality and delivery of video outputs.

 Design and oversee brand assets including logos, posters, full branding kits, letterheads and marketing

collateral.

 Manage design and video workflows from brief to final delivery across multiple concurrent projects.

 Maintain production quality and ensure creative outputs are delivered to the required standard and within

agreed timelines.

 Coordinate creative priorities across multiple projects and ensure that agreed actions are followed through to

completion.

 Provide creative direction and quality review while remaining hands\-on where production execution is required.

**Creative Skills \& Experience**

The following would be advantageous, with strong practical proficiency expected for the core production tools:

 Adobe Premiere Pro.

 Adobe After Effects.

 Adobe Photoshop.

 Adobe Illustrator.

 DaVinci Resolve (color grading).

 Canva (professional\-level use).

 Figma (UI/UX design).

 2D animation and motion graphics.

 3D animation.

 AI video generation tools.

 Video editing and post\-production.

 Brand identity design, including logos, letterheads and full branding systems.

 Poster and marketing collateral design.

 UI/UX oversight and quality review of application design and front\-end output.

 Creative team leadership and creative workflow management.

Added advantage (not mandatory):

 Pre\-production experience, including script writing.

 Cinematography knowledge — camera positioning, shot composition, and the ability to advise across

production departments.

A strong portfolio demonstrating expert\-level execution across design AND video disciplines simultaneously is

important. Proven experience leading a creative team, working directly with executive leadership, and

independently managing multiple creative workflows end\-to\-end would be advantageous.
